messages:
olivia_customer: Help — promo code '6MOFF-DEV' rejected as invalid during EUR checkout. It worked a minute ago when I tried USD. Request id: r_12ab34cd. Screenshot attached.
emma_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact request payload/endpoint and the account email so I can look it up?
olivia_customer: Email: olivia@acme.co
```
curl -s -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checkout' -d '{"plan":"pro","currency":"EUR","promo":"6MOFF-DEV"}' -H 'X-Request-Id: r_12ab34cd'
```
emma_support: Thanks — checking the promo catalog and logs now. one sec.
emma_support: Dashboard shows 6MOFF-DEV is configured with allowed_currencies: ["USD"] only. That would return invalid for EUR. Escalating to billing to confirm intended scope.
lex_billing: Hi — confirmed: this promotion was created for a USD-only campaign (partner payout constraints). We can either expand allowed_currencies to include EUR (needs revenue sign-off) or apply a manual credit for this account. Which do you want?
olivia_customer: Manual credit please — customer needs to close the purchase today.
dan_engineering: Quick tech note: checkout service validates promo.allowed_currencies against the request.currency. The runtime returned 400 with code promo_invalid which is expected here. No evidence of a parsing bug. We should surface currency on promo-creation UI so creators don't forget.
emma_support: Created manual credit record CR-2026-784 for olivia@acme.co — forwarding to billing bot.
billing-bot: manual_credit_created #CR-2026-784 amount 6.99 EUR for account olivia@acme.co (created by emma_support)
deploy-bot: promo-catalog updated (change id p_upd_998) — allowed_currencies field updated: USD,EUR
lex_billing: I've requested retroactive campaign approval from revenue for this code; I'll follow up if denied. For now the credit stands.
olivia_customer: Customer confirmed they received the manual credit and completed checkout. Thanks everyone :tada: 
emma_support: Closing thread. Follow-up ticket created to update promo creation flow: ENG-PRM-452.
